limitations: Phase 10 verifies report schemas, derivations, provenance and interpretation boundaries with fixtures; it does not create live workflow measurements.
Unavailable and not-instrumented values remain null and are never interpreted as zero.
Avoided work and reviews are counterfactual and require an explicit derivation or estimate; they cannot be labelled directly measured.
Provider assertions, human reference review, Flickr labels, raw scores, calibrated probabilities and release status retain distinct maturity semantics.
Blocker categories may overlap and are reported as memberships, not unique blocked-record totals.
No production speedup, memory reduction, review saving, quality gain or blocker clearance is claimed.

tasks.outcome: Reports all ten adaptive admission stages from exact source-bound media memberships, with explicit unavailable states and branching-stage semantics.
Reports nine efficiency dimensions with measured, derived, estimated, fixture or unavailable evidence while preserving every work unit.
Embeds an immutable six-label maturity legend that prevents provider support, raw scores or probabilities from inheriting human-review or release claims.
Reports seven blocker kinds with fixed selective-resume actions, source provenance, release impact and explicit human-input requirements.
